purpose: OBR costing of the high value council tax surcharge (2 April 2026): Table 1.1 and 1.2 properties in scope by band for 2028-29 to 2030-31 (static and post-behaviour) and the paragraph 1.13 non-owner-occupied share. Consumed by the uk_high_value_homes_benchmarks diagnostic gate and the high-value home stock builder's owner-occupied control (microcosm#1240).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
